description: Per-page documentation content + SEO enrichment progress for the TrizLink docs site. Resumable across sessions: the first page with status != 'complete' is the next thing to work on.

seoFloorPerPage: definition-first intro, use cases, how-it-works steps, tips, 5-7 FAQ, distinct title + meta description, ~700-1000 unique words

runHistory.summary: Created trizlink-docs from the native-update-docs structure. Adapted brand (TrizLink blue), config, SEO (JSON-LD WebSite+Organization+SoftwareApplication, robots AI-bot allowlist, llms.txt). Wrote all 23 baseline pages covering every real TrizLink feature, hitting the SEO uniqueness floor. Dual hosting (Firebase + GitHub Pages) configured.

All 23 rows reset to pending. The site describes the OLD product - intro says Firebase/Firestore (it is Supabase), features/browser-extension describes an extension that does not exist. TASK-001 re-derives every page against the rebuilt app in trizlink/. Every row read "complete" and every row was wrong, which is why the reset is the first commit rather than a per-page correction.

Batch 1 of 3 re-derived against the rebuilt app: 9 pages, 10,756 words. 24 false claims removed with file:line evidence - Firebase/Firestore (it is Supabase/Postgres), six "real time" claims (there is no realtime anywhere in the app), the QR download button, /dashboard/tracking/utm-templates, a fourth bio template, an OS breakdown, an expiry webhook event, ten "free platform" claims, and TrizLink -> Trizlink (89:0 in the app catalogue, and the Story Bible bans the camel-case form). Also fixed in the main session: the site-wide hardcoded canonical (every page canonicalised to /) and docs/DONE-TASKS.md shipping as a public page - both found by grepping build/ rather than reading the config.

nextSteps: Re-derive each page against ../trizlink/ source; flip its row to complete only when written and built green.
